title: The upkeep made me choose between two creatures
era: 2023 Old School with modern triggered-ability rules
matchup: U/G Control against Naya creature aggression
story: I began my upkeep controlling Drop of Honey and no creatures. Across the table my opponent had Kird Ape beside a Taiga , and Savannah Lions . Both attackers had two power: the Taiga's Forest type kept the Ape at 2/3. Drop of Honey's ability triggered, and I chose the Lions from the tie for least power. They were destroyed without regeneration. The Ape survived that upkeep, so the enchantment was not an instant board wipe. I passed, knowing the next upkeep could remove the Ape too if no new smaller creature appeared.
review: Kird Ape becomes 2/3 with Forest-type Taiga; Savannah Lions 2/1 both power 2. Drop untargeted tie chooses one at resolution. Only Lions die this upkeep, Ape stays. Controller creatureless.
